ALTER PROCEDURE DW.SP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERRISKRATING
AS
BEGIN

WITH  DimCustomerRiskCCD AS(
SELECT *, 'TU Score' AS RiskRatingTypeID FROM DW.DimCustomer where SourceSystemCode = 'CCD')

, DimCustomerRiskSEC AS (
SELECT *, 'ECRAF' AS RiskRatingTypeID FROM DW.DimCustomer where SourceSystemCode = 'SEC')

, CustomerRiskRatingSK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerRiskRatingSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimCustomerRiskRating 
)

, TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating AS
(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM CustomerRiskRatingSK) AS CustomerRiskRatingSK
    ,* FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
 DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerID AS CustomerID
,DRRT.RiskRatingTypeSK AS RiskRatingTypeSK
,DRR.RiskRatingSK AS RiskRatingSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                     
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DB  ON DC.BankSK = DB.BankSK
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating BCOCR ON DC.CustomerID = BCOCR.CustomerId AND DB.BankID = BCOCR.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRatingType DRRT ON BCOCR.RiskRatingTypeId = DRRT.RiskRatingTypeID AND DC.BankSK = DRRT.BankSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRating DRR ON BCOCR.CreditRiskId = DRR.RiskRatingID AND DC.BankSK = DRR.BankSK
--LEFT JOIN DW.DIMcustomerACCOUNT DA ON DC.CustomerSK = DA.CustomerSK
WHERE DC.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT
 DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerID AS CustomerID
,DRRT.RiskRatingTypeSK AS RiskRatingTypeSK
,DRR.RiskRatingSK AS RiskRatingSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
JOIN DimCustomerRiskCCD DCRC ON  DC.CustomerID = DCRC.CustomerID 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CreditCardApplication BCCA ON DC.CustomerID = BCCA.CustomerId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRating DRR ON BCCA.RiskRating = DRR.RiskRatingID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRatingType DRRT ON DCRC.RiskRatingTypeID = DRRT.RiskRatingTypeID 
--LEFT JOIN DW.DIMACCOUNT DA ON DC.CustomerSK = DA.CustomerSK
WHERE DC.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT
 DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerID AS CustomerID
,DRRT.RiskRatingTypeSK AS RiskRatingTypeSK
,DRR.RiskRatingSK AS RiskRatingSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
JOIN DimCustomerRiskSEC DCRS ON  DC.CustomerID = DCRS.CustomerID 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRatingType DRRT ON  DCRS.RiskRatingTypeID = DRRT.RiskRatingTypeID 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating BCOCR ON DC.CustomerID = BCOCR.CustomerId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRating DRR ON BCOCR.CreditRiskId = DRR.RiskRatingId
--LEFT JOIN DW.DIMACCOUNT DA ON DC.CustomerSK = DA.CustomerSK
WHERE DC.SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'
    )A

)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating FROM TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating;


--SELECT * FROM #TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating
WITH
TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID
    ,RiskRatingTypeSK
    ,RiskRatingSK
    )) HASHROW, CustomerID
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID
    ,RiskRatingTypeSK
    ,RiskRatingSK
    )) HASHROW,CustomerID
    FROM DW.DimCustomerRiskRating WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    WHEN TGT.CustomerID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID

WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.CUSTOMERID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimCustomerRiskRating TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;


INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerRiskRating(
CustomerRiskRatingSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,RiskRatingTypeSK
,RiskRatingSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm                    
)
SELECT distinct
CustomerRiskRatingSK
,CustomerSK
,SRC.CustomerID
,RiskRatingTypeSK
,RiskRatingSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm   
FROM #TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimCustomerRiskRating_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')
WHERE RiskRatingSK IS NOT NULL;
END
